name: automation-tools
description: Manage SOP templates, scheduled automation tasks, and automation run history through AI-callable tools.
description_cn: 让 AI 可以管理 SOP 模板、定时自动化任务和执行历史。
workflow: List templates or tasks first when the current automation state is unclear.
Create or update templates before binding a scheduled task to them.
Ask for approval before deleting or running a task.
